contexts.text: The Lord... is uncreate and infinite... and because He is uncreate and infinite. He is Esse itself... and Life itself From the uncreate, infinite, esse itself, and life itself, no one can be created immediately. Explained.
Comparison of the uncreated Man, who is God, with the created man.
Esse and Existere in itself is also uncreate; and everything created must be from the uncreate.
That there are three infinite and uncreate degrees of height in the Lord. Explained.
